requirement: Annual rent increase capped at 5% + CPI, maximum 10%, for covered units.

coverage_conditions.notes: Statewide Tenant Protection Act; local rent control may supersede for covered buildings.

exemptions: Certain single-family / condo with exemption notice
quoted_span: the landlord may not increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living
